description: Rootless container egress to GitHub, used by rpi-omt-client's gate toolbox for the two pinned release binaries it installs (hadolint and trivy) and for the RustSec advisory database that cargo-deny clones on every supply-chain gate. The githubusercontent alternation is not optional: GitHub redirects release-asset downloads to those hosts, so a rule naming github.com alone allows the request and denies the payload. This is the widest rule in the band — it is host-scoped rather than repository-scoped, because neither the redirect targets nor a git clone expose the repository to the firewall.
name: 082-omarchy-allow-container-egress-to-github-downloads
